quotes.text: i want to start a new milestone first. I'm planning on sharing this out with few people soon and i need to get a polished readme and documentation in place. if my humanize plugin isn't installed we need to install it for all the docs. it's in my dotfiles

fields.summary: The owner plans to share Rhiza with a few people soon and wants a polished README and documentation. The humanize skill (voice engine from the owner's dotfiles) was installed first so all doc prose goes through it. Settled through multiple-choice picks of the agent's options: the audience is developers who try Rhiza on their own repo; install by go install plus tagged GitHub releases built with GoReleaser, first version v0.1.0; docs are Markdown in docs/ with the README as front door (the tabled landing page stays tabled); docs lead with the CLI model working alone, with Rex and Claude Code as requirements for runs and the daemon; the doc set is README and quickstart, concepts, agents/runs/daemon, and reference; the CLI, config and workflow reference is generated and checked stale by make check; the repo goes public under MIT, after an audit of git history and .rhiza/ for secrets, personal data and private hostnames, with the owner flipping visibility by hand; humanize is a standing rule for human-facing doc prose, generated reference exempt; the quickstart covers the model loop without agents so a testscript can run it; all six change sets are planned now; the agents/runs/daemon docs wait for the queued workflow work (dispatch, per-workflow autonomy, schedules, refs, warnings) to land.
fields.title: Milestone 30 planning: ready to share
